codeReview.summary: Re-reviewed the feature entry, mission guidance, prior scrutiny context, the session `16db9c85-5f40-42d4-ba20-53ebbda077a9` handoff/transcript skeleton, the `web-control-plane-worker` skill, and current HEAD for `apps/web` tests/components. The component-side fix from `f31995614069acf3aa7fd90c01bd16a3a9d04e64` is still present and correctly wraps the affected audit/detail cards in `dl` containers, but no later code change has added structural regression coverage for the populated Linear audit-card path. `apps/web/tests/account-shell.test.tsx` still runs `findDescriptionListViolations` only against the signed-out `audit: null` shell, and `apps/web/tests/linear-management.test.ts` still checks populated audit content without asserting description-list semantics. Because the validated routed `/account` flow that originally logged the hydration error included populated delivery and closeout audit cards, the prior blocking coverage gap still stands on current HEAD.

issues.description: The only structural regression assertion for this follow-up still lives in the signed-out shell test (`apps/web/tests/account-shell.test.tsx:661-680`), while the shared fixture keeps `linearManagement.audit` null (`apps/web/tests/account-shell.test.tsx:136`). That means the account-shell suite never renders the populated delivery/closeout audit cards from the routed `/account` validation evidence in `.factory/validation/env-hardening-closeout/user-testing/flows/web-env-linear-state.json`, so the real audited path remains unguarded.

Current populated-audit coverage still verifies only rendered text (`Repo audit trail`, `Latest delivery reconciliation`, `Mission closeout audit`, etc. at `apps/web/tests/linear-management.test.ts:678-697`) and never checks `dl`/`dt`/`dd` structure. A future regression that reintroduces invalid description-list markup inside `DeliveryAuditCard` or `CloseoutAuditCard` would therefore still pass the populated-audit test.

summary: Fail. Current HEAD still does not add structural regression coverage for the populated Linear delivery/closeout audit-card state from the original routed `/account` hydration report, so the prior blocking issue remains unresolved.
